title: Beyond the Hype: AI Adoption, Governance, and Roles
abstract: Greg invited me to host a roundtable at the t3 CTO Summit. More than twenty engineering leaders joined. I share the notes and examples I prepared on AI adoption, governance, and roles.
meta-title: Beyond the Hype: AI Adoption, Governance, and Roles | t3 CTO Summit
meta-description: Notes from hosting a t3 CTO Summit roundtable: how to adopt AI so work is shippable, who owns tools when things go wrong, and what shifts for juniors and seniors.
